name: Text Stash – Clipboard History
description:
Clipboard history for text, built for large copies.

Everything you copy is saved to disk and kept for 14 days by default (you can change this), so even multi-megabyte copies survive logouts and restarts. Press Super+Shift+V to open a searchable popup, then press Enter to paste straight into the app you were using.

• Searches the full text, even inside very large copies
• Pinned items are never deleted
• Ctrl+1–9 pastes one of the top nine items
• Pastes into terminals with Ctrl+Shift+V automatically
• Skips copies that password managers mark as secret
• Text only, and nothing leaves your computer
